notes.title: Minor Update for Linux version
notes.content:
I have found an issue with the Linux version of Times Tables Hunt that lead to launching issues from the Steam client. This was fixed and everything should be working fine again. Please reach out in case you have any issues!
Best regards,
Johannes

notes.title: Huge Update, Amazing New Features and a Little Halloween Special
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42233859/146e5150fa9a6305c757f379bffde18ae2132c39.png[/img]

We worked on the update until the very last minute but now it's ready for you:

[b]Halloween special:[/b] unlock the bonus landscapes and you'll find the secret jack-o'-lantern. Please don't disturb him!

[b]Brand new content:[/b]
[list]
[*] New unlockable landscape with custom music and sunset atmosphere
[*] Better gameplay, realistic darts hit the balloons
[*] Post-game feedback for better learning experience
[*] Didactically better assistance - developed together with teachers
[*] School mode, specially developed for educational institutions
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42233859/f1b61a574162afb0806ab31169bae3bf63fd616c.png[/img]
